name: Convy
tagline: Telematics infrastructure for enterprise fleets that refuse to guess.
positioning: Convy unifies every vehicle, sensor, and dispatch decision into one live operating layer — so fleet directors act on ground truth, not yesterday's spreadsheet.

hero.h1: Every vehicle, telling the truth in real time.
hero.sub: Convy turns raw CAN-bus signals, GPS, and driver behavior into one auditable operating picture — the platform enterprise fleet teams standardize on across every depot.

features.title: Live Vehicle Ground Truth
features.description: Second-by-second location, engine load, and fuel state from every asset — no more reconciling three trackers that disagree at the loading dock.

features.title: Driver Safety Scoring
features.description: Harsh braking, speeding, and distraction events scored per driver, per route, with coaching workflows that reduce collision claims measurably.

features.title: Predictive Maintenance
features.description: Fault codes and wear signals trigger service tickets before a truck strands a delivery — cut unplanned downtime across the fleet.

features.title: Compliance & ELD Records
features.description: Hours-of-service, IFTA mileage, and inspection logs generated automatically and export-ready for any DOT audit.

features.title: Geofence Automation
features.description: Trigger dispatch alerts, dwell-time billing, and yard-arrival events the moment an asset crosses a boundary you define.

features.title: Fleet Analytics API
features.description: Stream normalized telematics into your BI stack, TMS, or data warehouse with one documented, versioned endpoint.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated four regional tracking vendors onto Convy in a quarter. Idle-time billing disputes with our 3PL partners basically disappeared once everyone read from the same event log.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The predictive maintenance tickets paid for the contract in the first winter. We caught coolant-loss patterns on 40 tractors before a single one broke down on I-80.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: Our DOT audit used to eat two weeks of a compliance analyst's month. Convy exports the HOS and IFTA records in an afternoon, and the auditors stopped asking follow-ups.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
